description: Run the pre-send email check on a saved campaign, sequence email step, or template: the same rules as the editor's email checker plus live verification of every link and image. Use it before sending or activating to catch broken links (404s, dead domains, bad certificates, redirect loops), links missing https://, localhost/staging/preview URLs, placeholder domains such as example.com, mistyped schemes, link shorteners, link text that shows a different domain than the link, invalid mailto/tel links, broken or oversized images, leftover placeholder copy (lorem ipsum, [First Name], TODO), name merge tags without a fallback, missing alt text, spam-trigger wording, Gmail clipping risk and email-client compatibility problems. Pass exactly one target: campaignId, sequenceId plus nodeId, or templateId. Links in every A/B variant and translation are checked unless variantId or locale pins one version. Returns score, grade, placement, per-category scores, issues (each with severity, rule, message and, when it has one location, blockId and url) and links (every link and image with its live status: ok, broken, invalid, server_error, unreachable, restricted, personalized, not_checked). restricted means the site refused an automated check (for example 401, 403 or 429) and may work in a browser, so it is not counted as broken. Links built from per-recipient merge tags are reported as personalized and only syntax-checked; {{company.url}} links are resolved from the company website. Sender settings are not evaluated here. Read-only: it never edits or sends.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

links.description: Verify every link and image over the network (HTTP status, redirects, DNS, TLS, image type and size). Defaults to true; pass false for a fast, rules-only check.

locale.description: Force a localization locale instead of deriving it from the contact.

nodeId.description: Email step node ID from get_sequence. Requires sequenceId.

subscriber.description: Personalize as an ad-hoc contact that need not exist in the account. Mutually exclusive with subscriberId.

customAttributes.description: Custom attributes used by merge tags and blocks.

tags.description: Tags this ad-hoc contact carries, used to evaluate `tag` block conditions. Nothing is stored. Without it a tag condition has no tags to read and renders as false, so only the else branch of a tag split can be previewed. Every other stored-state condition (segment, list, event, engagement, purchases) still needs subscriberId.

subscriberId.description: Check as this stored subscriber: picks their localization and reports merge tags and conditions that would not resolve for them. Link and content rules always run on the email as written. Mutually exclusive with subscriber. Needs the subscribers:read scope as well.

variables.description: Extra merge variables layered over the contact's attributes. Values are HTML-escaped; content can prefix a tag with 'html.' ({{html.subscriber.body_html}}) to render a trusted, sanitized HTML value unescaped, and this tool previews that exactly as a send would.

variantId.description: Check a specific A/B test variant of the campaign or sequence step. Required for sequence steps whose nodeType is action_ab_test: those steps have no emailId of their own, and copy lives on get_sequence.sequence.emails[].abTest.variants. Checking a sequence variant also needs the ab_tests:read scope, the same scope get_sequence uses to return competing variant copy.

variationId.description: Render a design variation of the campaign's email or of the sequence step's email instead of the email (from list_campaign_variations or list_sequence_email_variations). Not with variantId. A variation still generating, or one that failed, can't be rendered.

name: check_email

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `check_email` MCP tool.

categories.description: Per-category scores as { subject, preview, content }, each { score, maxScore }.

entity.description: Which entity was checked: type, id, and variantId.

grade.description: Letter grade: A, B, C, D or F.

issues.description: Findings sorted by severity, as [{ category, severity, message, rule?, blockId?, url? }]. severity is "error" (fix before sending), "warning" (review) or "info" (tip). rule is a stable id such as links.broken, links.missing-scheme, images.missing-alt or content.placeholder-text; its prefix groups it (links, images, content, subject, preview, accessibility, compatibility). blockId names the block to edit when the issue has one location.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

linkSummary.description: Counts over links: total, checked, ok, broken, warnings (server_error + unreachable), restricted, notChecked.

links.description: Every link and image in the email, as [{ url, kind, label, blockId, blockType, status, httpStatus, finalUrl, message, findings }]. kind is "link" or "image". status is the live result - "ok", "broken" (404/410, unknown domain, certificate problem, redirect loop), "invalid" (can never work: a rule found it unusable, such as localhost or a missing https://, or it resolves to a private address), "server_error" (5xx), "unreachable" (timeout or refused connection), "restricted" (the site refused an automated check, e.g. 401/403/429; it may work in a browser) - or "personalized" for merge-tag URLs filled per recipient, or "not_checked" for mailto/tel links, links not reached before the 25-second limit, and when links is false. findings lists the no-network rule results for that URL.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

linksChecked.description: Whether live link verification ran. False when links was false.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

placement.description: Predicted inbox tab: Primary, Promotions or Spam.

previewText.description: Preview text with merge tags resolved, or null when unset.

score.description: Overall score from 0 to 100 across subject, preview text and content, including live link findings. Sender settings are not part of this check.

subject.description: Subject line with merge tags resolved for the checked contact.

unevaluatedConditions.description: Block conditions this check could not decide; same meaning as in render_email.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

unresolvedMergeTags.description: Merge tags that did not resolve, as [{ tag, reason }]; same meaning as in render_email.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
